prompt: Inspect the exact provisioned native listener, then make exactly one play-arrangement-and-listen call for Arrangement beats 0 through 4 with maximumDurationMs 8000 and only the bound listener ID. The staged developer candidate legitimately remains ready=false with native_per_pass_validation_required; attempt fresh per-pass validation, never promote it or use any other listener. Query the resulting pass and historical typed context if available. Queued or arming acceptance is not completion. Leave playback running: do not stop, rewind, record, launch Session clips, change the Set, install devices, or claim exclusive clip audio. Unknown attribution and freshness are valid historical track/range results.

setupContract.sourcePolicy: Immutable explicitly provisioned Set with project-relative native candidate references. Every referenced WAV must be explicitly hash-pinned. External Max devices, unprovisioned audio, symlinks and mismatched resources fail before launch; no XML rewriting or installation.
setupContract.stagingPolicy: Fresh .test-artifacts/native-listening-{runId}/fixture; byte-identical copied Set and candidate code/device, only copied discovery configuration regenerated with the shared storage resolver for the isolated automation profile.
setupContract.processPolicy: No pre-existing Live permitted. Launch the copied Set only through the runner's newly recorded exact PID. Never adopt another process.
setupContract.insertMarkerPolicy: Fresh-load the approved saved zero-marker fixture. currentSongTime/currentBeat zero plus stopped transport does not prove Song.start_time zero. The public inspection schemas do not expose the insert marker; Python must independently enforce it after genuine arming and before source mutation. A mismatch is a failed pass with no published contexts, never repaired by transport stop/seek, retry, or guard weakening.
setupContract.cleanupPolicy: Capture completion/cancellation/failure leaves transport running. Application shutdown, exact-PID Live shutdown and owned fixture deletion are separate stages. Retain fixtures beneath surviving processes.
setupContract.productionComposition: createAgentRuntime + createListeningRuntimeHost + createSessionContextHost + createDesktopSessionContextManager + JsonSessionStore. No test capture adapter, new product API, Desktop window or readiness promotion.
setupContract.reviewStatus: Deterministic harness implemented. Real runner-owned native acceptance and copied-resource resolution remain unqualified until explicitly run with a safe provisioned fixture; existing operator-owned SDK passes are not runner evidence.
